links.outcome: Consistency of model rankings across benchmark, automatic, LLM-judge and human expert evaluations
links.effect: Finetuned Llama 3.1 70B led on multiple-choice and automatic metrics, ranked second to Claude 3.7 in LLM-as-a-judge, while human experts favored Claude 3.7 and RAG for complex queries.
links.quote: Our findings reveal substantial performance heterogeneity across evaluation methodologies, underscoring assessment complexity.

links.outcome: Human expert preference for RAG-grounded outputs versus finetuned models on complex queries
links.effect: Human expert evaluation favored Claude 3.7 and RAG approaches for complex queries; no numeric effect reported in the abstract.
links.quote: Human expert evaluation favored Claude 3.7 and RAG approaches for complex queries.

screen.reason: Empirical study evaluating domain-specific fine-tuned LLMs and RAG against proprietary LLMs for ECG knowledge queries, incorporating human expert evaluation and testing retrieval-augmented generation as an adaptation/grounding strategy.
